g.text: SAMPLE TEXT — NOT APPROVED ADVICE. This two-sided layout demonstration
Do not enter moving water or work where a slope, wall, roadway, or escape
route may become unsafe. Reviewer must replace or confirm this wording.
Choose stable ground away from traffic
Keep a clear route away from the work area
Clear loose debris only if it is safe to do so.
Place each bag flat and close gaps between bags.
Stagger joints in later rows rather than lining up seams.
